meta.title: Bakery and pastry shop in Paris 15, rue de la Convention | L'Artisan des Gourmands
meta.description: Bakery and pastry shop at 60 rue de la Convention, Paris 15: best chocolate éclair in Île-de-France 2025, croissants, baguettes, cakes to order. Closed Wednesdays.
meta.ogAlt: Six éclairs from L'Artisan des Gourmands in their box, next to the bakery's name

hero.eyebrow: Bakery · Pastry shop · Rue de la Convention
hero.title: The éclair is our signature
hero.sub: Best chocolate éclair in the Île-de-France region, 2025. And every morning, croissants, baguettes and pastries made right here in the 15th.

fresh.title: Made here every morning
fresh.text: Bread, viennoiseries and pastries come out of our own oven.

salon.title: A small tea room
salon.text: A few tables inside and on the terrace, for a coffee and an éclair.

eclairs.title: An award-winning éclair, and the whole family
eclairs.text: Well-baked choux pastry, a generous filling, a glossy glaze. In 2025, our chocolate éclair was named the best in the Île-de-France region. Coffee, vanilla and salted caramel sit beside it in the window, and other flavours come and go.

cakes.title: The cake for your celebration
cakes.text: Birthday, christening, farewell drinks: tell us how many servings, the message and the pick-up time. Layered cakes, saint-honoré, fruit tarts to share, croquembouche, and the galette des rois in January.

salon.title: Take your time, have a seat
salon.text: A few tables inside, and the red chairs out on the terrace along rue de la Convention. A cappuccino, a slice of tart, and the 15th going by.

special.title: For the big occasions
special.intro: Order online or by phone, at least 48 hours ahead. For a croquembouche or a large quantity, let us know a week before.

anniversaire.title: Birthday cakes
anniversaire.text: From 4 to 30 servings, with the message of your choice.

entremets.title: Layered cakes and saint-honoré
entremets.text: Our window pastries in large sizes, to share.

pieceMontee.title: Croquembouches
pieceMontee.text: Filled choux and caramel, for a christening, a communion or a wedding.

galette.title: Galettes des rois
galette.text: In January, to order or in the shop. Tell us how many servings.

bureaux.title: Office platters
bureaux.text: Mini viennoiseries, éclairs, pastries: for your meetings and team breakfasts.

fetes.title: The festive season
fetes.text: Layered cakes and cakes to share for Christmas and New Year's Eve. Order early: the last dates go fast.

rois.title: The galette des rois
rois.text: All-butter puff pastry and almond cream, with its charm and paper crown. Tell us how many servings.

reviews.title: What our customers say
reviews.intro: More than nine hundred customers have reviewed us on Google. What comes up most: the éclairs, the croissants and the baguette.

infos.title: Coming to the shop
infos.accessText: Between Javel and Boucicaut. Boucicaut metro (line 8) is about a 5-minute walk; Charles Michels and Javel–André Citroën (line 10, RER C) about 7 minutes.
infos.mapTitle: Map to L'Artisan des Gourmands, 60 rue de la Convention

items.q: How far ahead should I order a cake?
items.a: At least 48 hours before pick-up. For a croquembouche, a large number of servings or an office platter, let us know a week before. In a hurry? Call us on 01 45 78 14 10, we can often work something out.
Every day except Wednesday. Monday and Thursday to Saturday from 7 am to 8 pm, Tuesday and Sunday from 7 am to 7 pm.

The labels in the window list the main allergens (gluten, milk, egg, nuts…). Ask us in the shop, and mention any allergy in your order: we will tell you what is possible. Everything is made in the same kitchen, so we cannot guarantee the absence of traces.

items.q: Do you make galettes des rois?
items.a: Yes, in January, in the shop and to order. Choose the number of servings and the pick-up day in the order form.

items.q: Do you do platters for offices?
items.a: Yes: mini viennoiseries, viennoiseries, éclairs and pastries, for a breakfast or a meeting. Tell us the date, the number of people and what you would like, and we will come back to you with a proposal.

items.q: How do I pay for my order?
items.a: In the shop, when you pick it up. Nothing is charged online.

footer.tagline: Neighbourhood bakery and pastry shop on rue de la Convention. The éclairs, the bread and the viennoiseries are made here.

eclairs.metaTitle: Éclairs in Paris 15: best chocolate éclair in Île-de-France 2025 | L'Artisan des Gourmands
eclairs.metaDescription: Our chocolate éclair was named the best in the Île-de-France region in 2025. Coffee, vanilla, salted caramel and flavours of the day, rue de la Convention, Paris 15.
eclairs.title: The éclair is our signature
eclairs.lead: It's what comes up most in your reviews, and what we are proudest of.
eclairs.awardText: On 14 October 2025, the Fédération des pâtissiers d'Île-de-France announced the results of its regional chocolate éclair competition. First place: Filipe Fernandes, of L'Artisan des Gourmands, 60 rue de la Convention.
eclairs.awardSource: Read the Sortir à Paris article (in French)

how.title: The choux pastry
how.text: Baked all the way through, golden, holding its shape in your hand.

how.title: The filling
how.text: Generous from end to end, never too sweet.

how.title: The glaze
how.text: Thin and glossy, applied by hand, never sticky.

eclairs.flavorsMomentList: Saint-honoré, red berries, lemon, pistachio, and other ideas that pass through the window.
eclairs.folieText: One Sunday in March, the shop's chalkboard announced fifteen flavours at once: speculoos, pear, rose, pecan, Baileys, popcorn, blueberry, tea… A day apart, and a good picture of how we approach the éclair.

patisserie.metaDescription: Artisan pastry shop in the 15th, between Javel and Boucicaut: award-winning éclairs, fruit tarts, tropézienne, saint-honoré, flan, cakes to order. Open 6 days a week.
patisserie.title: A neighbourhood pastry shop on rue de la Convention
patisserie.lead: Between Javel and Boucicaut, a window full of tarts, éclairs and layered cakes, made in our own kitchen.

sections.title: What you'll find in the window
sections.text: Strawberry, lemon and raspberry tarts, tropézienne, Le Bourbon (opera-style), saint-honoré, flan pâtissier, and individual cakes such as Les Alpes and La Chaîne d'Alaska. And of course the éclairs, including the chocolate one that won in 2025.

sections.title: To take away or to enjoy here
sections.text: Take your pastries home, or sit down in our tea room corner, inside or on the terrace, with a coffee.

sections.title: Large sizes, to order
sections.text: Most of our pastries come in a version to share. Order them 48 hours ahead, with the number of servings you need.

anniversaire.title: Your birthday cake, from rue de la Convention

steps.title: Choose the cake
steps.text: Layered cake, saint-honoré, fruit tart, or an idea of your own: describe it.

steps.title: Servings and message
steps.text: From 4 to 30 servings. A message of your choice on a plaque.

steps.title: Pick-up day and time
steps.text: At least 48 hours after ordering, on a day we are open. We call you back to confirm.

anniversaire.note: Allergies, candles, special decoration: mention it in the notes and we'll talk it through on the phone.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.dataText: Information sent through the forms (name, phone, email, order) is used only to process your order or request. It is never sold or used for advertising. You can ask for it to be deleted by calling the shop.
legal.creditsText: Photos of the shop and its products, published on its Google listing.
